targets.query:
from(bucket: "PVS")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "PVS6")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kW")
  |> last()

data = from(bucket: "PVS")
    |> range(start: -25h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "PVS6")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "system")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kWh")

currentData = data
    |> last()

pastData = data
    |> range(start: -25h, stop: -24h)
    |> timeShift(duration: 24h) // Shift timestamps forward by 24 hours
    |> last()

joinedData = join(tables: {current: currentData, past: pastData}, on: ["device"])

result = joinedData
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time_current,
        _value: r._value_current - r._value_past,
        _field: "difference" // Rename the field to reflect the difference
    }))
    |> yield(name: "difference")

from(bucket: "PVS")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "PVS6")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kWh")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "PVS")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "PVS6")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kW")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "PVS")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "PVS6")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kW")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with
        prefix_value: strings.substring(v: r.device, start: 0, end: 8)
    }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.prefix_value == "inverter")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: [], mode: "by")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_field"], columnKey: ["device"], valueColumn: "_value")
